reviews.title: Costs money
reviews.text: It’s a fine app. It woke me up. But I really hate that nothing is a flat one time payment anymore. This app is subscription based. 30 dollars a year. But it doesnt make that information readily available on the store page. It’s not much money but wtf. It’s one app that does a single thing. Imagine buying a car and instead of paying a certain amount and then stopping after it’s paid off, you just continued paying monthly for as long as you own it. Slimy way to make more money from your products. Subscriptions are only appropriate when the service provides new content every renewal period.

reviews.title: Incredibly Frustrating!
reviews.text: A friend who has the hardest time getting up recommended this app to me. I have it a try and it seemed helpful for a couple days BUT then there were issues with it going off after the alarm. I only had one alarm on my phone and on this app. I stopped the alarm but within two minutes it went off 5x asking me to answer math problems and then didn’t accept multiple correct answers. Very frustrating when you’re trying to get ready!!!!! I canceled the free trial and deleted the app and then got charged!!! I can’t get a hold of customer service to see about a refund. If I can give 0 stars I would…

reviews.title: Deleted Alarms Still Go Off
reviews.text: I do really like this app because it makes me wake up and get energized, but it kept waking me up for alarms that I turned off. Then I deleted all my alarms, like literally every single one, and it STILL went off at 6am on the weekend. How can it wake me up for an alarm I deleted?

reviews.title: Best Alarm App
reviews.text: Whoever made this app understands that the problem isn't waking up it's STAYING up. Every other alarm just makes noise and I turn it off without even opening my eyes. SnoozeProof makes you complete a mission first and you can't shortcut it. I take a photo of my toothbrush every morning and by the time I've done that I'm already brushing my teeth to start my day. Insanely simple concept but is easily the most life changing app I've ever downloaded

reviews.title: BEST APP 100%
reviews.text: My friend told me about this app and I figured I’d try it since the apple alarm isn’t reliable. I turned it to the barcode mission setting, so I have to get up and scan the peanut butter in my fridge to turn off the alarm. I have such a love hate relationship with it but it 1000% will get you out of bed in the morning and awake enough to where you don’t want to go back to sleep! If you’re not a morning person, you will be. or if you can’t get up with one alarm, you sure will with this one.
